name: Combinatorial / logical arbitrage: dependent markets, same-game market types, strike and date ladders
one_line: Trade violations of logical constraints across separate markets (ladders, nested deadlines, same-game lines, implication pairs); frequent but ~15-share, sub-cent sized.
requires_ai: optional: proposing dependencies across unrelated markets
edge: Separate books, no converter across markets, slow resync in play
opportunity_size: NBA: $560 capped per 173 games; live: 3 sub-cent ladder crossings in 884 pairs
competition: few specialists; fast sports makers in play
validate: Nightly ladder scan + one NFL weekend replay; pass >=10 episodes/week >=$5 net
top_risk: Semantics errors (hit vs close, units) and per-leg fees
solo_fit_reason: Cheap and safe but capacity is tens of dollars a month; best as a consistency layer inside a quoting engine.
speed_class: latency-sensitive in play (16 s episodes, 1 s delay); speed-insensitive for ladders
changes_made: Live ladder scan 24 Sep; NFL/CFB same-game legs fee-free, so NFL in-play episodes are delay-gated not fee-gated.
open_doubts: Depth at live crossings not checked.
